results.authors: Zangirolami, Marcela de Souza; Leoncio, Mariana Silva; Santos, Oscar O.
results.title: The Use of a Standard Cell Phone Camera as a Quick, Cheap, and Non-Destructive Analytical Tool to Quantify the Content of Soluble Solids in Ketchup
results.abstract: The soluble solids content (°Brix) is an important parameter in the sensorial and nutritional quality of ketchup. This work developed a novel approach for determining soluble solids in ketchup through digital image processing. Image acquisition and processing were performed using a smartphone and the refractometer analysis was used as a reference method. Samples were divided into calibration, validation, and prediction sets, and the images were captured and processed using the Redgim app. Pre-processing consisted of selecting regions of interest (ROI) followed by partial least squares (PLS) regression. The latent variable was chosen by “leave-one-out” cross-validation based on calibration model prediction errors (RMSECV). The predictive ability of the model showed high accuracy (R² > 0.99) and low uncertainty (RMSEP < 0.55), demonstrating a fast, non-invasive, and cost-effective alternative for predicting soluble solids content in ketchup.
results.keywords: Ketchup, Soluble Solids, Digital images, Smartphone, Multivariate data analysis
